params.description: If passed, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is passed) or Variable/Field reference (if * is omitted).

params.name: selector
params.description: Preference to get (a WA... constant from the Web Area theme).

discriminatedBy.rule: Text (an object name) when the leading * is passed; Variable or Field passed directly when * is omitted.

constraints: selector must be one of the WA... preference constants defined in the Web Area theme; value is always returned as a Boolean (True = active, False = not active).
The 'WA enable URL drop' selector always reads back False when the Fluent UI rendering theme is used on Windows (drag & drop unsupported there).
